# R5.9 — Shared first-valid grade selection and immutable revisions

**Deviation (conspicuous):** 959 changed source/test lines vs the ≤800 split trigger — stopped at the trigger; scoped review ruled **AMEND** (44d1c7ed, atomic X6 contract, no documented sub-seam). Accepted as recorded Deviation.

- **Spec:** docs/tickets/178_R5.9__selection.md · docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md §2.2 steps 5–6 · PADR-R5-1 A.1 items 5–7 / A.3 / A.4 (admitted GATE-G9) · partition X6
- **Requirement ids:** REQ-E-204, REQ-E-103 (primary); REQ-E-102 (contributing only — never duplicated ownership)
- **Depends on:** GATE-G9, R5.8 · base `codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.8` (@d8c5162a)

## Summary

Implements the admitted shared pure grade-selection contract **once** in
`hharness_eval::selection` — first-valid grade selection inside the
frozen valid-grade set plus authorized append-only invalidation /
immutable selection revisions. Pure: no eval→ledger edge; the owning
consumer resolves durable verdicts into owner-validated `GradeAttempt`
facts and composes `select_grade`/`plan_disposition` (X6: callable
contract first so no consumer ever reimplements selection).

## What changed

- `crates/hh-eval/src/selection.rs` (new, 649): `ValidGradeSet` (frozen
  pins + `eligible_set_ref()` content address), `GradeAttempt` /
  `GradeOutcome`, `SelectionRevision` + append-only `RevisionLog`,
  `select_grade` / `select_grade_at` (watermark-scoped), `plan_disposition`,
  `SelectionError` typed refusals, canonical JSON wire forms.
- `crates/hh-eval/src/lib.rs`: `pub mod selection`.
- `crates/hh-eval/tests/r5_9.rs`: 7-test AC-1/AC-2 battery (pure scratch,
  offline, $0).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0388-*`: 7 landing decisions (incl. authority proof =
  named `authority` field, no new principal/role/endpoint); BL-47
  sources + regenerated index/triggers.
